Subject: Pen test asset map, evidence bundle & remediation status (Acme)

Team —

Acme's security team asked for the final penetration test artifacts and a short remediation status table that maps each finding to a ticket owner and target ETA. They want a single bundle we can hand off (PDF report + evidence archive + remediation matrix). I attached the scope they sent back and their evidence checklist.

Can Security/Eng fill in the locations for the following items and a current status by EOD tomorrow so I can coordinate the external delivery:

- Full pen test report (final or draft PDF)
- Evidence bundle (pcap, screenshots, scan exports) and S3/Drive path
- Remediation matrix (owner, ticket, ETA, risk level)
- Any PII/IP redaction that needs to happen before we share externally

Initial ask: point me to the authoritative locations (Drive folder or internal S3 path) and the single approver for external release. If there's anything blocked on legal/docu sign, flag it.

Attachments: [Attachment: acme_pen_test_scope.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

- Evidence bundle (raw): s3://redwood-pen-tests/acme/2025/pcap-and-scan-exports/ (redwood-internal)

- MEDIUM: 8 findings — owners assigned across infra & app teams — target ETA: 2025-11-21

Notes / blockers:

- S3 path is restricted to Security + Eng; I can generate a signed bundle for Acme if we get final approval.

They asked explicitly whether the redaction step is required on our side or if they will accept the unredacted bundle under an NDA.

Can we confirm:
- Who will be the single point of contact for delivery (name + email)?
- Timeline for redaction and final bundle (if needed)?

Thanks for the fast responses. Plan below — please confirm by EOD today so I can notify Acme:

1) Single POC for delivery: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com) — Monica will produce a signed, redacted bundle if Legal requires redaction.
2) Redaction: Diego to run the redaction script if Legal requires it (~1 business day). If Acme signs the NDA and accepts unredacted artifacts, we will provide a signed access token to the S3 bucket instead.
3) Final report: Legal sign-off required for the PDF cover page (Karthik, can you expedite?).
4) Remediation bullets for customer-facing email (draft):
   - "High-risk issues have been remediated or mitigations are in place; owners and timelines are listed in the attached remediation matrix."
   - "Medium/Low findings are scheduled with target completion dates; we will provide weekly status updates until complete."
   - "We will share a redacted evidence bundle or a secure access token per your preference under NDA."

Action items (owners):
- Monica: prepare signed bundle or S3 access + attach remediation_matrix.csv (due 2025-11-05 17:00 PT)
- Diego: produce redacted pcap bundle if required and update JIRA tickets (due 2025-11-05 17:00 PT)
- Karthik: legal sign-off on cover page and redaction policy (due 2025-11-05 12:00 PT)
- Evelyn: coordinate delivery logistics with Acme and confirm NDA preference (due 2025-11-05 12:00 PT)

Once all confirm, I'll draft the customer-facing email and send it from CS with Monica on the delivery.

Attachments: [Attachment: remediation_matrix.csv (CSV)]
